annotation.title_clean: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/510 of 6 March 2026 on revising the European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
annotation.title_en: Commission Recommendation (EU) 2026/510 of 6 March 2026 on revising the European assessment framework for ‘safe and sustainable by design’ chemicals and materials
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
named_instruments_referenced: Regulation (EU) 2025/2455 common data platform on chemicals
annotation.summary_en: European Commission Recommendation revising the voluntary 'safe and sustainable by design' (SSbD) framework for chemicals and materials, adding scoping analysis, tiered safety, environmental (LCA) and socioeconomic assessments, and encouraging Member States, industry and research bodies to apply it in R&I. Not about AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Revises Recommendation (EU) 2022/2510 establishing the SSbD framework
Adds scoping analysis and socioeconomic sustainability dimension
Tiered, iterative safety and environmental assessment based on hazard criteria and LCA/PEF
Encourages FAIR data sharing via EU common data platform on chemicals
Voluntary; creates no new legal obligations
